resources.string: Point this device at your licence server
Type the address of the computer running QServe Vendor — its name or its IP, and the port, like 192.168.1.5:8090. This device remembers it, so you type it once.
Enter the address of your licence server.
This device is not on the same network as the licence server, or it is not running.

You sign in on the next screen with the developer account your licence server created the first time it ran. Its password was written once to the log on that computer: QServe Vendor → logs → vendor.log. Signing in lasts twelve hours and survives closing this app.
